description: T cell activation is dependent on presentation of antigen by MHC-II on APC, CD28 and CD3.
Represents receptor desensitisation once differentiation begins (IL2:2) and predicted miR-34c-5p targeting.
Naive CD45 receptor (alpha isoform) is activated by phosphorylation by LCK.
LCK phosphorylates ABL1, which phosphorylates ZAP70. miR-34c-5p has been shown to target ZAP70 mRNA.
Partial ZAP70 activation persists even under miR-34c-5p repression (level 2 blocked, level 1 not).
CD28 and LCK activate PI3K.
PIP3 is formed by PI3K transfer of phosphate from PIP2; required for PDK1 activation.
PDK1 phosphorylates PKB(AKT1), activating it. AKT1 inhibits growth-arrest and pro-apoptotic proteins.
CDKN1A(p21) promotes growth arrest and is inhibited by phosphorylation by AKT1.
RAC1 is activated downstream of ZAP70 via VAV1/VAV3; predicted and validated miR-155-5p target.
p38 activation downstream of RAC1.
SRF is activated by VAV3-dependent RAC1 signalling.
JNK phosphorylates and activates JUN. JUN is a predicted and validated miR-155-5p target.
ERK activates FOS by phosphorylation. FOS is a predicted target of both miR-155-5p and miR-34c-5p.
TP53 promotes FOXO1 transcription; AKT1 phosphorylation excludes it from the nucleus; miR-155-5p targets AKT1.
ZAP70 leads to IP3 formation via PLCG1 splitting PIP2 into IP3 and DAG.
ZAP70 leads to DAG formation via PLCG1 splitting PIP2 into IP3 and DAG.
IP3 triggers calcium release; calcium-calmodulin activates calcineurin.
Calcium-dependent NFATs are dephosphorylated by calcineurin and translocate to the nucleus.
CARD11+BCL10+MALT1 complex; all three subunits are predicted miR-155-5p targets.
Canonical NFKB activation after the BCM complex and IKB degradation, reinforced by TNFR.
TNFR-independent NFKB activation once IKB is degraded.
IKB is bound to NFKB in the cytoplasm; IKK phosphorylation releases active NFKB.
CARD11+BCL10+MALT1 and DAG-dependent phosphorylation are required for IKKG activation; a predicted miR-34c-5p target.
GTP-bound RAC1-activated MEKK1 leads to JNK activation.
RAS signalling activates ERK; ERK is a predicted and validated miR-34c-5p target.
PKB (AKT1) inhibits GSK3B.
GSK3B inhibits CTNNB1 (beta-catenin).
GSK3B inhibits CCNI (cyclin I).
ZAP70 downstream interactions activate RAS (intermediate steps omitted for model simplification).
RAS/ERK signalling phosphorylates RPS6KA1 (RSK), which activates CREB.
High IL2 requires NFAT+NFKB, or an AP1/STAT5 route blocked by STAT5+STAT6 or NFKB+TBX21 co-inhibition.
Baseline IL2 production requires NFAT or NFKB (classically), or AP1 (JUN+FOS).
IL6 requires NFAT and STAT3, at least under Th17-polarising conditions.
TGFB requires NFAT and FOXP3, at least under iTreg-polarising conditions.
IL12 production.
IL21 is activated by RORC or MAF, but suppressed in the presence of TGFB.

formula: NFAT & RORC & !FOXP3 & NFKB & STAT3 & !(STAT5 | STAT1 | STAT6)
description: STAT3 and RORC cooperatively activate IL17; blocked by FOXP3 and by STAT5/STAT1/STAT6 (IL2/IFN/IL4 axes).
TNF is trans-activated by TBX21 and induced by JUN.
IL23 is up-regulated by AP1, p38, NFKB/RELA and STAT3.
IL4 (Th2 signature cytokine) requires NFAT and GATA3/STAT5/MAF, and is inhibited by TBX21.
IL10 production requires SP1 and MAF, plus one of GATA3/STAT3/TGFB/STAT1.
IFNG (Th1 signature cytokine) requires TBX21 or STAT4 with NFAT, absent FOXP3 and STAT3.
FOXO3 is activated by TP53 and self-maintains; targeted by miR-155-5p; deacetylated (inactivated) by SIRT1.
TP53 self-upregulates given MYC input, free of MDM2 sequestration and SIRT1 deacetylation.
Baseline TP53 activity requires absence of MDM2 and SIRT1.
MDM2 is activated by NFAT/SP1 and TP53, needs AKT1 for nuclear translocation; predicted miR-155-5p target.
Baseline MDM2 activation by NFAT and AKT1.
STAT3 activates the SP1 promoter; NFKB, CDKN1A and TP53 repress it.
MYC requires STAT4/STAT3, absence of BLIMP1; MYC is a validated miR-34c-5p target.
IFNGR activates STAT1; predicted miR-155-5p and miR-34c-5p target.
IL12 (Th1-polarising) activates STAT4 in the absence of GATA3.
High STAT5 requires high-level IL2R or IL4R engagement.
Baseline STAT5 from low-level IL2R/IL4R engagement.
IL4R signals through STAT6 to activate GATA3 transcription.
STAT3 is activated by Th17-polarising cytokine receptors; predicted target of both miRNAs; deacetylated by SIRT1.
The IL-2 receptor requires the common gamma chain and activates STAT5 upon binding.
Baseline IL-2 receptor engagement.
IL6R is activated by bound IL6; predicted miR-34c-5p target.
TGFBR is activated by bound TGFB; predicted miR-34c-5p target.
IL-21 receptor requires CGC, is activated by MAF or STAT3, except in the presence of TGFB.
TNFR is activated by bound TNF; predicted miR-34c-5p target.
STAT3 and RORC activate IL23R transcription; IL23R is also activated by IL23.
High-level IL-4 receptor engagement, activating STAT6 and STAT5.
Baseline IL-4 receptor engagement by bound IL4.
IL10R is activated by bound IL10; predicted miR-34c-5p target (IL10RB).
IFNGR is activated by bound IFNG; miR-155-5p targets IFNGR1.
AHR with RORC and TBX21 activate IL22; MAF mediates TGFB-dependent suppression of IL22.
PU.1 activates IL9 transcription.
TBX21 (Th1 master regulator) positively self-regulates given STAT1 or STAT4.
Baseline TBX21 activation by STAT1 or STAT4.
GATA3 (Th2 master regulator) is activated by STAT6 with NFKB and self-maintained; predicted miR-34c-5p target.
Baseline GATA3 activation.
RORC (Th17 master regulator) is activated by STAT3, promoted by TGFB signalling.
FOXP3 (iTreg master regulator) self-maintains given STAT5 and NFAT; predicted miR-34c-5p target.
De-novo FOXP3 induction, blocked by STAT1 or the STAT3+RORC combination.
BCL6 (Tfh master regulator) requires STAT3+STAT4 or SPI1, absent the TBX21+miR-34c-5p combination.
TGFBR promotes SPI1 (PU.1) activity; miR-155-5p inhibits its translation.
MAF requires STAT5 (IL2 route) or STAT3 (IL6 route); the STAT3 route is blocked by TGFB+miR-155-5p.
AHR (Th22-associated) is induced by SP1+NFKB, or MYC+GATA3, or FOS+JUN (this last route blocked by miR-34c-5p).
IL12R is activated by bound IL12.
STAT3 accounts for IL1R differential expression in naive Th vs Th17 cells.
BLIMP1 requires AP1 (JUN+FOS) or STAT3, and absence of BCL6.
CREB and FOXO3 activate SIRT1 transcription; TP53 inhibits it. (Transcribed exactly as published; see model_notes.md.)
Enhanced miR-34c-5p transcription: GATA3+MYC plus one of TP53/FOXO3/SP1 (ChIP-seq-supported).
Baseline miR-34c-5p transcription requires GATA3 and MYC (which themselves control T-cell proliferation).
Enhanced miR-155-5p transcription with a Th master regulator present.
Baseline miR-155-5p transcription shortly after activation, requiring NFAT and NFKB.
MEKKK is activated downstream of ZAP70 (via LAT), leading to JNK activation.
